section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section focuses on the effectiveness of error training, particularly when combined with error management instructions, in improving performance in near and far transfer tests. The study found positive performance consequences for error training with instructions compared to error-avoidant training, with high effect sizes. It also examined the moderating role of avoidance and prove goal orientation, finding partial support for their function in error-avoidant training, but no support for learning goal orientation, attributing this to the 'strong situation' nature of error training. The section refers to 'This study' and 'the present study' in the singular.
